title: Libghostty 1.0 Released as Embeddable Terminal Library
summary: Libghostty 1.0 has been released as the first stable version of Ghostty&\#x27;s embeddable terminal-emulation library. The release makes Ghostty&\#x27;s terminal emulation available for reuse in other applications, targeting developers who would otherwise need to build that functionality themselves. The supplied material does not detail supported platforms, APIs, or compatibility.
